newsitem.title: USA: Lydall sees Q3 revs modestly below last yr.
newsitem.headline: Lydall sees Q3 revs modestly below last yr.

text.p: Lydall Inc said Wednesday it expects third quarter revenues to be "modestly" below year-ago levels. Last year earnings per share were $0.30, and net sales were $61.5 million, .
The company said that for the third quarter ending September 30, 1996, it expects to report a year-over-year increase in earnings per share of about seven percent.

The company said that on May 1, it projected 1996 earnings per share of about $1.41 on sales in the range of $265 million to $270 million. In light of anticipated third quarter results, it was now "tracking somewhat below those targets."

However, it added, it believes "this respite from the strong growth we have had over the past few years is just that -- a pause. The fundamentals of Lydall are sound, and we have many growth opportunities on the horizon. In the thermal area, sales of automotive heat shields continue to be healthy."

The company said that quarter to quarter, sales of these products had double-digit growth, while automotive builds are reported to be up only around 6 percent. Growth of the battery insulator product line also continues to be good.

Filtration sales overall are estimated to be relatively flat compared with record sales last year. Air filtration sales have grown at a "phenomenal" rate over the past two years; however, over the past few months, there's been a slight slowing. There have been some postponements of planned clean-room construction and customers are going through some inventory adjustments.
The company expects to report third quarter 1996 financial results on October 25.
